task: EVD-02 ACQUISITION AND EMPIRICAL CONTENT VERIFICATION
target_name: NREL Open Microgrid Diesel Generator Step-Load Dataset

acquisition_result.blocker_description: Search of NREL OpenEI / OEDI Data Repository (data.nrel.gov, openei.org/doe-opendata) confirmed that no downloadable time-series dataset exists under the identifier microgrid_diesel_stepload_2023 or title NREL Open Microgrid Diesel Generator Step-Load Dataset. NREL Flatirons Campus publishes general technical literature and droop control models, but raw CSV/HDF5 time-series recordings of diesel generator step loads are not publicly hosted for download.
